subject: revenuesystem.deployment.six_devices_no_subscription
summary: Owner requests a free operating approach for المطابقة on three computers and three Android devices.

details.cost_requirement: Find a no-subscription deployment using existing equipment; power, internet, maintenance and any new hardware remain real costs.

proposed_not_approved.hosting: Existing always-on Windows PC hosting authoritative API and SQL Server Express; three Windows clients and three Android clients share the API.
proposed_not_approved.connectivity: LAN/Wi-Fi locally; NetBird Cloud Free candidate for remote access, currently up to 5 network users and 100 machines; six devices do not imply six users. More than five distinct network users needs another plan or self-hosting assessment.
proposed_not_approved.limitations: Android app and API still require implementation; availability depends on host and network; no live deployment performed.

source.ref: 2026-10-24 request free operation on 3 computers and 3 Android devices
